h1:
Maha Sarakham Cafes
11 Spots to Work, Drink Good Coffee & Shoot Photos
intro: Maha Sarakham is a university town, so it has far more cafes than its size would suggest — especially around MSU on the Tha Khon Yang and Kham Riang side, where laptop-friendly spots stay open late on almost every corner. In town you'll find white-toned cafes built for photos and a few sitting right on the Chi River. We've pulled together 11 places from the reviews of locals and students, sorting clearly which ones suit long work sessions and which are better for shooting, plus the area, opening hours and rough prices for each.

blocks.html: What makes Maha Sarakham's cafe scene fun is the variety packed into a short drive. A few minutes from the new MSU side you'll find minimalist white-toned spots, wooden-house cafes, and coworking-style rooms open until midnight. Student-friendly prices mean a coffee usually lands in the 45–75 THB range, so you can sit all day without thinking too hard about it. We've ranked 11 cafes by popularity and how well they suit working, then split out separate photo and riverside picks below.

blocks.text: 11 Maha Sarakham Cafes Locals Actually Go To

items.name: My Space In Mahasarakham
items.blurb: The real-deal coworking cafe around MSU — minimalist, big tables, plenty of outlets, stable WiFi. It's the base camp for students and freelancers who need to sit and work for hours. The signature is the MySpace coffee, the cafe's own espresso blend. Easy to settle in all day without feeling cramped.
items.meta: MSU area (Kham Riang) · late morning to evening

items.name: Brotherhood
items.blurb: A warm vintage-toned cafe near MSU with plenty of space and several seating zones — both a quiet corner and an area for talking through work. It's a favourite for people who want to sit a long time without feeling rushed. Regulars often order the peach tea and the house-baked goods.
items.meta: Near MSU · late morning to evening

items.name: 00:15 COFFEE
items.blurb: A cafe near MSU that, true to its name, stays open until 12:15 a.m. It's a lifeline for night workers and students during exam season — quiet and easy in the evening, with good WiFi, ideal for reading or working after sunset.

items.name: Eat Read Oodlod Cafe & Bistro
items.blurb: An MSU-area cafe that brings coffee, books and food together under one roof. The quiet earth-tone vibe suits long reading sessions, with caramel macchiato and matcha latte on the menu — plus proper food if you get hungry mid-work.
items.meta: MSU area · late morning to evening

items.name: Macaff Coffee
items.blurb: A roadside cafe with a green, nature-leaning setup — lots of plants and several photo corners. Standout picks are the Vanilla Sky and the pizza toast. It suits anyone who wants good coffee and nice photo spots in one place, with easy parking.
items.meta: On a main road · late morning to evening

items.name: Taeyeon Cafe
items.blurb: A clean white Korean-minimalist cafe in town, sitting right by the river with an airy, breezy feel. There's a rooftop upstairs for catching the sunset, and plenty of photo corners — great for content creators who want good light.
items.meta: In town, riverside · late morning to early evening

items.name: White Balance Cafe
items.blurb: A white-toned cafe loaded with photo spots, with both indoor and outdoor seating and a bright, easy-on-the-eyes feel. People talk up the coconut americano and the bakery. Best for shooting in the late morning when the light pours in.
items.meta: In town · late morning to early evening

items.name: 5th Avenue Cafe Mahasarakham
items.blurb: A European-style cafe in the town centre, decorated more upscale than the usual student spots — good for a work meeting or an easy meal. Popular orders are the latte, matcha latte and honey toast. It's quieter than the MSU zone.
items.meta: Central Maha Sarakham · late morning to evening

items.name: November Homemade Bakery and Coffee
items.blurb: A warm minimalist cafe in town whose selling point is homemade bakery baked fresh every day — good if you come for the pastries as much as the coffee. There's seating for shorter work sessions, with a quiet, easy atmosphere.
items.meta: Central Maha Sarakham · late morning to early evening

items.name: Nordic House - Car&Coffee
items.blurb: A clean, modern cafe with Nordic-style decor. Frequent orders are the coconut latte and the mango cheese pie. Good for a quick coffee stop or an easy afternoon sit — relaxed and not crowded.
items.meta: In town · late morning to early evening

items.name: prattle.
items.blurb: A minimalist cafe near MSU with a particular focus on tea. The quiet vibe suits working solo or reading. People talk up the toffee cake and the peach tea — a small spot that tea lovers go for.
items.meta: Near MSU · late morning to evening

blocks.title: Tips for working in Maha Sarakham cafes
blocks.html: During midterms and finals, the work-friendly cafes around MSU like My Space and 00:15 COFFEE get packed in the evening. If you want a seat near an outlet, go before 6 p.m. And if you're after real quiet, try a weekday late morning when students are still in class.

blocks.text: Work cafes around MSU — Tha Khon Yang & Kham Riang

blocks.html: If your main goal is to open a laptop and work for hours, the MSU zone is the answer — the cafes here are built for students who sit all day, with lots of outlets, good WiFi and easy prices.

items: My Space In Mahasarakham — big tables, plenty of outlets, full-on coworking vibe; good for sitting all day.
00:15 COFFEE — open until 12:15 a.m., a lifeline for night workers and exam season.
Brotherhood — lots of space and several corners, so you can pick quiet or talk-through-work.
Eat Read Oodlod — coffee, books and proper food if you get hungry mid-work.

blocks.text: Photogenic cafes and Chi River spots

blocks.html: If you're shooting photos, you'll like the white-toned cafes in town where the light pours in, and the riverside cafes on the Chi River with natural views. Several have a rooftop or outdoor corner for catching the evening light.

items.name: Taeyeon Cafe
items.blurb: Korean-minimalist white tones by the river, with a rooftop for the sunset and plenty of photo corners.

items.name: White Balance Cafe
items.blurb: Bright white tones with indoor and outdoor seating; lovely light in the late morning.

items.name: Cheewan Cafe
items.blurb: A cafe on the Chi River with open natural views and an outdoor garden feel — good for sitting back and catching the breeze.

items.name: Macaff Coffee
items.blurb: A green, nature-leaning spot with plants and several photo corners — good coffee and nice shots both.

blocks.text: How to pick the cafe that fits your style

items.name: Working all day
items.blurb: My Space or Eat Read Oodlod — lots of outlets, stable WiFi, sit without being rushed.

items.name: Working late
items.blurb: 00:15 COFFEE stays open until midnight — a lifeline during exams and for night owls.

items.name: Shooting photos
items.blurb: Taeyeon and White Balance — white tones, nice light, lots of photo corners.

items.name: Sitting back in the breeze
items.blurb: Cheewan Cafe on the Chi River — open natural views, perfect for an easy day.

items: Tha Khon Yang / Kham Riang (new MSU) — the hub for student-priced work cafes, open late, with the most spots in the province.
Central Maha Sarakham — white-toned photo cafes and European-style spots, easy to reach, near the market and souvenir shops.
Chi Riverside — open-air, nature-view cafes like Cheewan and Taeyeon, great for catching the breeze in the evening.
Along the main road — nature-leaning spots like Macaff with wide parking, easy to stop at along the way.

faq.q: Which Maha Sarakham cafe is best for working?
faq.a: My Space In Mahasarakham is the coworking-style cafe around MSU with big tables, plenty of outlets and stable WiFi. For working late, go for 00:15 COFFEE, which stays open until 12:15 a.m., and Brotherhood, which has lots of space and several corners to choose from.

faq.q: How much does coffee cost at Maha Sarakham cafes?
faq.a: Most drinks fall in the 45–85 THB range. Cafes around MSU run on student prices, starting around 45–75 THB, while European-style cafes in town like 5th Avenue can climb to 90 THB for special menu items.

faq.q: Which Maha Sarakham cafes are good for photos?
faq.a: For photos, people go for Taeyeon Cafe — Korean white tones by the river with a rooftop for the sunset — and White Balance Cafe, bright and white with lots of photo corners. If you prefer natural riverside views, try Cheewan Cafe on the Chi River.

faq.q: Are there any late-night cafes in Maha Sarakham?
faq.a: Yes — 00:15 COFFEE in the Kham Riang area near MSU stays open until 12:15 a.m. every day, and it's where students and night workers settle in during exams. Most other cafes close somewhere between early and mid evening.

faq.q: Where are the cafes near MSU in Maha Sarakham?
faq.a: The Tha Khon Yang and Kham Riang areas on the new MSU side are the hub for work cafes — the most spots, open late, at student prices. The white-toned photo cafes and Chi riverside spots are over on the town-centre side.
